name: Manticore

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The manticore makes three attacks: one with its Bite and two with its Claws, or three with its Tail Spike.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 100/200 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage. The manticore has 24 spikes, which regrow at a rate of 1d6 + 2 per day.

description: Manticores are lion-bodied, bat-winged predators with a spiked tail that hunt from the air, raining volleys of barbed spikes before closing in with bite and claw.
